← Dock

GroupMe Messages

Read your GroupMe groups and direct conversations, and send group messages from Dock. The open conversation checks for new messages every five seconds while this page is visible.

Run GroupMe Messages →

One connection setting

  1. Open GroupMe Developers → Applications → your application.
  2. Click Copy beside Your Access Token.
  3. In Cloudflare → Workers & Pages → chatgpt → Settings → Variables and Secrets, save it as a Secret named GROUPME_ACCESS_TOKEN. Deploy the settings.
  4. Run this project and choose Connect / refresh.

If you already saved that secret, leave it in place. No Client ID or callback authorization is needed.

Messages stay in GroupMe and are fetched on demand. This app does not save your conversations or token in browser storage. Use the Groups and DMs tabs for existing conversations. DMs are read-only because GroupMe does not make DM sending available through its Developer API. Attachments can be viewed in GroupMe. Group messages have heart reactions, quoted replies, and a Delete button for your own recent messages. GroupMe may restrict actions. Editing sent messages is not implemented: a supported Developer API endpoint could not be verified. Starting a new DM and SMS are not included.
